acceptanceCriteria: Collect reproducible cold/warm baselines for inspect/status/doctor/observe and single/parallel Work Item paths on the Cockpit repository.
Profile and identify measured hotspots before changing code; record telemetry and benchmark environment.
Implement only semantics-preserving optimizations with request-scoped identity keys, deterministic ordering, and fail-closed fallback when reuse or parallel safety is uncertain.
Preserve evidence, repository/runtime identity, Outcome markers and human-readable handoff semantics; no global active repository or shared project state.
Add regression/performance tests proving current repository and a fresh attached adopter inherit the same behavior and isolation.
Run fmt, clippy, workspace tests, performance gate, and release/adopter checks; no performance claim without measured before/after data.
goal: Reduce avoidable latency and resource cost for cold and warm single-Work-Item and independent parallel-Work-Item flows while preserving fail-closed governance, repository isolation, evidence integrity, deterministic outputs, and object-project inheritance.
intent: Improve Rust Runtime performance through measured, semantics-preserving, request-scoped and dynamic verification optimization for both the Cockpit repository and attached adopter repositories.
outOfScope: new governance semantics or weaker fail-closed behavior

scenarioCoverage.expected: Cold and warm inspect/status/doctor/observe measurements are reproducible and preserve identical governance facts.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the bounded performance harness against the Cockpit repository and retain identity-bound baseline evidence.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Exact identity matches may reuse safe observations, while any mismatch executes the required check and reports the reason.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: dynamic verification reuse and fail-closed fallback
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise matching and mismatching repository, snapshot, profile, runtime, command, scope, stage, runner, dependency and policy identities.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Independent Work Items can run concurrently without shared repository state, evidence, leases, or nondeterministic output.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run isolated single- and parallel-Work-Item measurements and compare repository identity, evidence bindings, output ordering and cleanup.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A fresh attached adopter receives the same optimized behavior and fail-closed boundaries without copying Runtime state.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the public installed Runtime against a temporary adopter repository and retain the adopter acceptance receipt.
